title: Realign the README and retire the legacy vertical documents
summary: The README and a set of older design documents still describe the v1 product: Playwright/Chromium setup, the web-audit Skill, and the retired five-state result vocabulary. The compiled-platform migration and the retired browser runtime make those instructions false. This change rewrites README.md to the Platform Constitution v2 model (declaration-only plugins compiled to one artifact, platform-owned Host lifecycle, bounded semantic review, exact verified artifact release) and marks the legacy vertical documents as superseded historical records rather than current authority. No document is deleted; each superseded document keeps its content and gains a banner that points at the v2 authority. No code, schema, compiled artifact, or runtime behavior changes.

platform: The platform owns the README and the authority status of platform documentation

forbiddenResponsibilities: The README must not describe a bundled browser, Playwright, or Chromium prerequisite
No superseded document may be deleted or have its historical content rewritten
A superseded banner must not claim the document is still current authority
acceptance: README.md contains no Playwright, Chromium, or web-audit Skill instructions
README.md describes the compiled declaration-only plugin model and the v2 review states
every listed historical document carries a superseded or historical banner
scripts/check_english_text.py, check_architecture_boundaries.py, check_document_boundaries.py, and check_plugin_source_boundaries.py stay green
scripts/run_tests.py fast and full stay green
